name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $92.7 on 18 Nov, 15% lower over a month; Iran says more tankers hit mines near Hormuz
state: Brent was near $92.7 early on 18 Nov, 3.3% lower on the week and 14.8% lower over a month, inside the $85–110 Watch band and 22% below its 52-week high of $118 (Yahoo Finance). Iran's Revolutionary Guards said two tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz on 15 Nov and that a supertanker carrying over 2 million barrels sank; the claim is not independently confirmed (AAP). No new outage above 2 mb/d was confirmed.
for_you: Oil prices feed into fuel, heating and transport costs with a lag of weeks. This describes conditions only.

sources.title: Newcastle Herald (AAP) — Two more oil tankers hit mines in Strait of Hormuz

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
